adaptation/org.jetbrains.compose.ui_ui/s.description: Implements the complete common key contract with SDL USB scan codes, keypad navigation variants and distinct unsupported-key identities.
Replaces the shared implementation with a Native atomicfu lock and an exactly-once contract; the prepared source shadow is removed for Gradle and IDEA.

adaptation/org.jetbrains.compose.ui_ui-s.description: Reuses the Native font-loading contract with scoped Data and base-typeface ownership.
Validates source and destination sizes, handles empty copies and avoids byte-count overflow before entering memcpy.

adaptation/org.jetbrains.compose.ui_ui-t.description: Preserves the atomicfu lock with PublishedApi visibility and an explicit try/finally block that satisfies the exactly-once contract on Native.

adaptation/org.jetbrains.compose.ui_ui-u.description: Preserves the upstream desktop tracing contract: execute the block once without collecting profiling events.
